minutes.title: Profit Strategy Meeting
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed strategies to achieve a 50 million euro profit, focusing on controls and their market potential. Decisions were made to conduct market research including competition analysis and feature development.

actions.task: Look into market potential for product, competition analysis, prices of other remote controls, specialty features, complexity of use
